发现分诊轮:**持有**(留 `finding`)+ 补域 **`domain:spec-tooling`**。

- **域锚定**:落点 `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts`(manifest 写触发条件那一段)—— 属 spec-tooling 座位的文件面(`packages/spec/scripts/**`),⛔ 不落 `domain:spec`(不动 `*.zod.ts`,不改任何可授权表面)。
- **为什么还留着**:正文的影响评估诚实且经得起复核 —— 三种手编(重排 `schemas` 数组、缩进/尾换行、重复条目)都不改变任何门禁判定,也不改变消费者行为(manifest 只被 `build-schemas.ts` 自己读),**今天为零**。这不是缺陷,是同一文件家族里两种严格度并存(`authorable-surface.json` 自 #4662 起整文件比对,manifest 只比键集 + #4725 的 description 一项)。
- **为什么不现在做**:改法本身很小(合并成「整文件 vs 规范序列化」比对,沿用 #4711 分叉),但**代价是任何格式漂移都要求跑一次 `gen:schema`**,而 **#5837**(按 category 分片三个单体 ratchet)与 **#4676**(投影类生成物是否退出仓库)都会重新动这个文件的形状。先动会做两遍。
- **重启条件**:#5837 或 #4676 **任一落地时并入** —— 谁先落地谁最省事地把两边严格度对齐;或在此之前出现第一例真实的手编漂移(重复条目最可能)。
- **前提检查**:来源单 #4725 的 `descriptionStale` 已在 manifest 写触发条件里(正文引用即当前形态),#4662 的整文件比对仍在 `authorable-surface` 侧 —— 两种严格度并存的事实成立。
- **查重**:#4662 / #4725 / #5837 / #4676 已在正文互链,三仓无独立重复单。

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine(#5474 试点),不构成认领。

Findings triage (#4949 discipline): **close (completed)** — the gap this finding records has been closed, incidentally, by #5837.

**Restart condition fired, and overshot it.** The 2026-08-06 13:57Z hold said: 「**#5837 或 #4676 任一落地时并入** —— 谁先落地谁最省事地把两边严格度对齐」. **#5837 is closed/completed** (2026-08-07T00:28:11Z). It did not merely create the opportunity to align the two strictness levels — **it aligned them**, because the alignment fell out of the reshard for free.

**Stale-premise check** (`origin/main` @ `42af12f`, read from the tree). The premise is not merely stale — **the file it is about no longer exists**:

- `packages/spec/json-schema.manifest.json` (the monolith) is **absent from main**. The manifest is now 14 category shards under `packages/spec/json-schema.manifest/` (`ai`, `api`, `automation`, `cloud`, `data`, `identity`, `integration`, `kernel`, `qa`, `security`, `shared`, `studio`, `system`, `ui`). The authorable surface was resharded the same way (15 shards).
- The write trigger quoted in the body — `manifestChanged = !manifest || added.length > 0 || renamedAway.length > 0 || descriptionStale` — is **gone**. `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts:560` now reads:

  ```ts
  const canonicalManifestTexts = schemaManifestShardTexts([...generatedKeys].sort());
  const staleManifestShards = [...canonicalManifestTexts]
    .filter(([name, text]) => manifestTexts?.get(name) !== text)
    .map(([name]) => name);
  const manifestChanged =
    manifestTexts === null || added.length > 0 || renamedAway.length > 0 ||
    staleManifestShards.length > 0 || orphanManifestShards.length > 0;
  ```

  That is a **byte-for-byte comparison against the canonical serialization**, per shard — structurally the same check `authorable-surface` has had since #4662. The script says so itself, in the comment directly above (`:551`–`:556`): *"Comparing BYTES rather than key sets is what keeps the shards' own description part of the artifact … **Sharding made the comparison stricter for free: hand-formatting inside a shard is now caught the same way #4662 catches it in the authorable surface.**"*

**All three named blind spots are now covered.** Checked one by one against the new trigger rather than assumed from the comment:

| body's blind spot | status under the sharded writer |
|:--|:--|
| reordering the `schemas` array | canonical text is built from `[...generatedKeys].sort()` ⇒ any reorder is a byte diff ⇒ `staleManifestShards` ⇒ reported |
| indentation / trailing-newline edits | byte diff ⇒ reported |
| **duplicate entries** (the one no set-comparison could ever see) | byte diff ⇒ reported. This was the sharpest of the three and it is the one the reshard closes most cleanly |

`--check` mode even distinguishes the case explicitly (`:576`): *"does not match its generated form (the key set is current)"* — the exact failure the finding said nothing would say anything about.

**Why closed rather than promoted.** There is no work left. The two-strictness-levels asymmetry the finding recorded is gone, and the resolution came through the route the hold predicted (「谁先落地谁最省事地把两边严格度对齐」) — it just cost nothing to whoever landed #5837, which is why it happened silently and needs saying here. Nothing to dispatch.

⚠️ **Attribution caveat, stated rather than glossed.** `git log -- packages/spec/json-schema.manifest/kernel.json` points at `db8c285`, whose subject is *"fix(plugin-auth): SMS daily-quota refusal answers 429, not 500"* — merge-queue batching makes single-commit attribution unreliable here, so **the evidence above is the state of the tree, not a commit message**. The verdict rests on the code at `build-schemas.ts:551`–`:565` and the absent monolith, both read directly from `origin/main`; it does not rest on which squash carried them.

Maintainer veto window applies as usual (#4949): reopen if you read the alignment differently.
